<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size: small;">Volume-equalized; dehissed and noise-cleaned.<br /><br /></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: small;">Fully chapterized. There are a few books (Cujo, Dolores Claiborne, The Shawshank Redemption, etc.) in which King included no parts, chapters, or numbers to separate.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: small;">All books encoded to a uniform MP3 96kbps 44.1kHz.<br /><br /></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: small;">All book files have been fully ID3 tagged and include full first-edition cover art. The full illustrations from the Dark Tower books are included.<br /><br /></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: small;">The two versions of the short story "The Mist" are not clean. Every other recording should be complete and high quality.</span></p>
